outcomes.observation: The exact Alt and Space labels make the documented shortcut legible, while the four-point editorial motif identifies the Gemini subject without inventing a screen or interface.
Bright cyan/tangerine/deep-ink contrast, black outlines, dense halftone and light-paper ground match the bound adult editorial reference more closely than v2.
No person, named character, real animal, place or LAiDIES identity appears.
The key rows, keycap spacing, long spacebar, Alt key, shadows and keyboard edge read as one plausible physical keyboard.
The only visible strings are deterministic, exact labels Alt and Space. No generated text, logo, fake UI, icon, badge or arrow is present.
The composition contains only contemporary keyboard hardware and an editorial motif; no wardrobe, historical prop or novelty device appears.
The Alt key, Space key and one four-point motif each explain the shortcut/product relationship; no decorative person, pane or unrelated prop remains.
At 720px and 360px, the Alt and Space labels and four-point motif remain readable as the dominant shortcut cue.

lineage.change: v3 replaces v2 generic laptop/panes with exact deterministic Alt and Space labels and a four-point editorial Gemini motif.

limitations: Producer self-review is not independent visual admission.
The four-point motif is an editorial product cue, not a claim to reproduce the live Gemini interface.
